reviews.text:
The exterior of the store was perfect for the winter night atmosphere. There was a waiting note at the entrance, but I thought it was worth the wait if I was the first one, so I waited about 10 minutes and went in.

The menu is designed with a sense of style, and the text is written mainly in Korean rather than English.

Since it says Hyemindang on the cake display case, I guess they got it from there. Cute Christmas candles (1,500 won) are also on sale. As we get closer to December, the Christmas mood begins to creep in.

The cakes were quite fancy, and the breads were also very colorful and varied.

There are a variety of egg tarts, croissants, red bean bread, ham and cheese bread, olive bread, queen amant, pies, cream bread, ciabatta, etc.

They sell coffee in drip bags and coffee beans, with a design that fits well with the name Oriental Medicine Shop. There is also a smart store QR. Among them, the herbal medicine gift package would be especially fun to give as a gift.

It's been a while since I had a cappuccino (5,500 won) that was delicious with soft milk foam and a strong coffee flavor. The cup is pretty, and I don't know if it's the atmosphere of the store or the Coffee Oriental Medicine Shop logo on the napkin, but drinking it made me feel like I was taking herbal medicine and it was fun.

The inside of the counter is decorated with mother-of-pearl cabinets, and the staff are wearing clothes that look like something out of a historical drama, Oriental Medicine Shop, which makes the atmosphere even better. There is also a fish tank in the middle of the store, adding to the retro feel.

There are restrooms inside the store, separated for men and women. You can use your own water and charge your cell phone yourself.

There were so many people that I was a little discouraged, but it still had a nice atmosphere so it was a cafe I wanted to go to again.

Good Day Seoul, a vegan bakery originally located in Nodeul Station, has opened a new location in Seongbuk-dong. As the store moved, the operation method also changed. With a 100% reservation system, you can enjoy a vegan afternoon tea set on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays, and classes are offered on other days of the week.
It's located inside an alley, but it's easy to find thanks to the mint-colored door. The narrow stairs leading up to the second floor of the building make you feel like you are going to a hidden hideout in the attic. The cozy space seen through the narrow hallway has four tables arranged in each corner. A bright space with a large open window and white interior.
The afternoon tea set for two people is 35,000 won and tea is included. You can pay a limited price of 5,000 won per person. You can choose between Fortnum & Mason (Queen Anne/Earl Gray Classic/Peach Black Tea) and Osulloc (Jeju Orchid Fragrance Green Tea/Chamomile/Blooming Camellia Gotjawal).
Afternoon tea consists of 1ea berry rice cake/1ea black sesame rice cake/1ea mugwort and fig glutinous rice donut/2ea savory peanut cookie/2ea chocolate coconut/1ea carrot walnut muffin/1ea sweet box cone/1ea cacao cone. The rest can be packaged.
It's like a gift to myself with healthy desserts, delicious tea, and a cozy space. And a place where the friendly owner always welcomes you warmly.
